name: Duatic DXTR
summary: A Swiss wheeled dual-arm mobile manipulator for intralogistics: two torque-controlled DynaArms lift up to 30 kg together for 10 s (12 kg continuous) and the base carries up to 200 kg.

germany.statusNote: Duatic AG in Glattbrugg (Switzerland) takes enquiries through the contact button on its product page; no price, delivery time or German partner is published.

sellers.name: Duatic AG
sellers.note: Thurgauerstrasse 119, 8152 Glattbrugg, Switzerland. Product page offers "Contact us"; every module (DynaArm, DuaTorso, DuaRover) is also sold on its own.

specs.label: Continuous payload
specs.conditions: system value, not split per arm

specs.label: Maximum payload (10 s)
specs.quote: Two coordinated arms lift up to 30 kg together, and the mobile base carries up to 200 kg on top.

specs.label: Base carrying load
specs.conditions: on top of the mobile base
specs.quote: the mobile base carries up to 200 kg on top

notes: Duatic calls it both a "dual-arm mobile manipulator" and a "half-humanoid"; it has a wheeled base, two DynaArms and a vision head.
Built for intralogistics on existing floor layouts (totes, cartons, sacks); the end effectors are not named.
The arm payload figure (12 kg continuous) is a system value; a single DynaArm is rated 6 kg continuous and 15 kg for 10 s.

images.alt: Duatic DXTR two-arm robot on a wheeled base

evidence.task: Maker says it lifts totes, places cartons and carries sacks on existing warehouse floor layouts

evidence.note: Shown on the maker's home page as "Duatic Alpha"; the link between the Alpha prototype and the DXTR name is not stated.
